subject.title: fix(qqbot): bound remote media downloads with header and idle timeouts

question: Should QQBot adopt a fixed 30-second no-progress timeout for remote media downloads, accepting failures for upstream bodies that pause longer than that interval?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow and uses the existing guarded reader, but selecting the channel-wide failure threshold is a compatibility and user-experience policy decision that source inspection alone cannot resolve.

options.title: Accept the 30-second QQBot policy
options.body: Land the bounded timeout as proposed to ensure stalled remote media releases channel and Gateway resources.

options.title: Choose a different channel policy
options.body: Ask for a revised QQBot-specific duration or an explicitly supported policy before changing existing transfer behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second QQBot policy
recommendation.body: Land the bounded timeout as proposed to ensure stalled remote media releases channel and Gateway resources.
